description: List the files in your Besidka library, newest first, with your storage usage. Each file has an id, name, media type, size in bytes, source and expiry. Pass nextOffset back as offset to continue. Requires signing in (files:read).

limit.description: Files to return, up to 50. Defaults to 20

offset.description: Number of files to skip, from nextOffset

search.description: Only files whose name contains this text

source.description: all (default), upload, assistant (files the assistant generated) or project (files used as project knowledge)

name: list_files
title: List my files
